upwork-vibe~upwork-job-scraper.description:
ABOUT THE PROJECT
We are an established online education provider specializing in state-regulated licensing courses. We are migrating our fragmented contact data into a unified GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM.

We have already completed the basic system architecture design, data scrubbing, and initial mapping. We are looking for a top-tier GHL and automation (Zapier, Make, etc.) expert to execute the technical build, support our historical data import, and create connections to our e-commerce and LMS platforms.

OUR TECH STACK
CRM: GoHighLevel (Moving to GHL)
E-Commerce: Ecwid (Payments via Stripe and PayPal)
LMS: TalentLMS
Ticketing: Zendesk
Legacy Data Sources: Mailchimp (Contacts), State Board Public Databases
Integration Engine: Zapier / Make.com

SCOPE OF WORK

PHASE 1: GHL Database Architecture & Historical Import
(Note: Our internal team will provide clean, scrubbed CSV files for all imports).

Build Custom Field Folders in GHL to track academic history (e.g., Course Start Dates, Expiration Dates, License Numbers).

Execute a multi-layer "Import & Update" using email as the primary key.

Import historical Mailchimp contacts (ensuring bounced/unsubscribed emails are strictly mapped to GHL's DND feature).

Update existing profiles with TalentLMS historical course data (Status, Start/Complete dates).

PHASE 2: Product Mapping & Tagging Infrastructure

Build out the native "Products" library in GHL to match our Ecwid SKUs for financial tracking.

Establish a strict "Prefix Tagging" system (e.g., Purchased: FL CAM CE, Status: Refunded, Trigger: Send Certificate) -- no messy tag dumps.

PHASE 3: Advanced Zapier Webhooks & GHL Automations
You will build specific, automated workflows to handle various E-Learning scenarios:

The "Bundle" Zap: When 1 specific 'Bundle' SKU is bought in Ecwid, Zapier must simultaneously mark user as enrolled into multiple separate courses in GHL.

Continuing Education (CE) Looping: Set up "Ghost Tag" sequences and toggle "Allow Re-entry" in GHL workflows so students can buy and take the exact same CE course every two years without automation errors.

The CE Renewal Zap: Build a Zapier webhook that handles CE repurchases by automatically removing the user from the expired TalentLMS course and instantly re-enrolling them to reset their progress to 0%.

Automated Refund Protocol: When an order is marked "Refunded" in Ecwid, Zapier must revoke TalentLMS access, remove "Active" GHL tags, apply a "Refunded" tag, and pull the user out of all active promotional workflows.

GHL Date Math: Build internal workflows to calculate certificate expiration dates (e.g., Add 365 days to "Course Complete Date") for courses that lack state board public data.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You are a GHL expert who understands the difference between a Tag (for action) and a Custom Field (for permanent memory).

You have deep experience building multi-step Zapier webhooks and routing logic using SKUs.

You know how to use GHL's "Update Empty Fields Only" vs "Add New & Update Existing" import features to merge data safely.

You have experience integrating E-commerce platforms with Learning Management Systems (LMS).

You are highly organized, document your Zapier builds, and test thoroughly before going live.
questions: In GHL, if a customer buys a Continuing Education course that they are required to take every 2 years, how do you structure the workflow settings and tags so that the automation successfully fires again when they buy the exact same course in 2028?
